progressive_disclosure.L1: SKILL.md YAML frontmatter (name + description) — loaded at agent start
progressive_disclosure.L2: SKILL.md body — loaded when skill matches the task
progressive_disclosure.L3: references/* and scripts — read_file only when needed

entries.name: skills-ecosystem
entries.description: Browse/install community skills via npx skills (skills.sh). Not a SKILL.md bundle — use CLI then copy into skills/imported/.
entries.install: npx skills find <query> && npx skills add <owner/repo@skill>
